model: A19 Direct Connect Color Changing Clear
name: GE Cync Direct Connect A19 Color (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi set up in the Cync app. CSA lists Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; GE's page mentions Bluetooth only in an FAQ.

matter.note: GE's page for SKUs 93132325 (1-pack) and 93132326 (2-pack) says Matter compatible. CSA lists 'Cync Full Color Direct Connect LED A19' by Savant (Wi-Fi and Bluetooth); no CSA listing names a SKU.

apple_home.note: GE says Apple Home works through Matter; an Apple home hub is needed for remote use.

google_home.note: Cync's bulb FAQ says Direct Connect bulbs work with Google Assistant with no extra hub; GE also lists Google through Matter.

alexa.note: Cync's bulb FAQ says Direct Connect bulbs link to Alexa through the Cync skill or Frustration Free Setup; GE also lists Alexa through Matter.

smartthings.note: GE lists Samsung SmartThings through Matter.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has an official cloud Cync integration (2025.10), but its docs list no models, and nothing names this bulb for HA's Matter integration.

hubRequired.note: GE says no hub or bridge is needed.

localControl.note: GE's product page does not state local control. Cync's general bulb FAQ says Direct Connect bulbs can still be controlled without internet, but does not name this model.

colorType.note: Sold as Full Color; GE also mentions a tunable white range.

bulbBase.note: GE says 'medium base'; in the US that is E26.

summary: GE Cync Direct Connect A19 color bulb works with Apple Home and SmartThings over Matter, and with Alexa and Google Home through Cync, all over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and with no hub. It's an 800-lumen medium-base bulb. CSA lists a Matter-over-Wi-Fi certificate for the Cync Full Color Direct Connect A19. Home Assistant isn't confirmed.
caveats: GE sells several similar Cync color bulbs; check the SKU (93132325 or 93132326) before buying.
Apple Home needs an Apple home hub for remote use.
GE's shop page showed 'Sold out' on 2026-10-12.
